label: Venture Drafters Instagram
role: The main channel. Every piece starts here unless it is a LinkedIn text post.

weekly.label: Reel (Collab with Palak's Instagram)
weekly.why: Monday Reel: a 35 to 60 second b-roll with Palak or an animated episode, captions burned in, published from Palak's account with the page as collaborator so it sits on both grids. Two feed posts a week, no more.

weekly.label: Trial Reel (optional, off the grid)
weekly.why: An optional third Reel off the grid, to test a slot without raising the weekly count. Skip it when there is nothing ready.

weekly.label: Carousel
weekly.why: Thursday carousel: 5 to 10 slides at 1080 x 1350, the saveable, forwardable piece of the week, shared to Palak's Stories.

Automatic share to the Facebook page

label: Venture Drafters Facebook page
role: Automatic: turn on 'Share to Facebook' in Instagram once. No separate posting.

label: YouTube
role: Every Instagram Reel as a Short, the same evening. One long episode every other Monday at 11:00 from 16 November 2026 (Built to Run: Stories), with Shorts between, so there are never fewer than two uploads a month. The VSP-system case studies join the alternate Mondays once one is produced.

weekly.label: YouTube long video (30 to 45 minutes)
weekly.why: One long episode every other Monday at 11:00, from 16 November 2026: a 30 to 45 minute story of a business that runs on systems (Built to Run: Stories), live before that evening's Reel can point to it. Shorts fill the Mondays between, so the channel never has fewer than two uploads a month. The measure is "watched before the call", not subscribers. It is a scheduled upload with no live reply, so it goes up even inside a dark block such as Diwali; the go-dark switch for mourning still holds it.

repurposeTo.how: Pin to Featured on Palak's LinkedIn

label: Venture Drafters LinkedIn page
role: Friday only: reshare the week's strongest post from Palak's LinkedIn, with one line. No original posts.

weekly.label: Company page: reshare the week's strongest post
weekly.why: The company page is a trust signal, not a channel: organic page reach is about 1.6 per cent. It reshares Palak's strongest post of the week with one line, at least two hours after the original.

label: Palak's LinkedIn
role: The main written channel. Two a week; the fortnightly PDF carousel is one of the two.

weekly.label: LinkedIn post
weekly.why: Palak's LinkedIn is the main written channel: the designer who built the tools, in the first person, 900 to 1,900 characters plus one real photo. Two a week, never two in one day; Tuesday and Thursday 8:30 am in November.

weekly.label: PDF carousel (alternate weeks, replaces Thursday)
weekly.why: A PDF carousel of 6 to 10 slides every two weeks is one of the two weekly posts; it replaces that week's Thursday post so the count stays at two.

weekly.label: LinkedIn post (weeks without a carousel)
weekly.why: Palak's LinkedIn is the main written channel: the designer who built the tools, in the first person, 900 to 1,900 characters plus one real photo. Two a week, never two in one day; Tuesday and Thursday 8:30 am in November.

repurposeTo.how: If it is the week's strongest post, reshare it from the company page on Friday with one line

label: Palak's Instagram
role: Monday Reel as a Collab post (one post, on both grids). Thursday carousel shared to Stories.

label: Palak's Facebook
role: Share the Monday Reel once a week from the Venture Drafters page. Nothing else.

label: WhatsApp Status (Palak)
role: Tuesday and Thursday about 9 am, Saturday optional. Three a week at most.

weekly.label: Status: a glimpse
weekly.why: The warm network sees Status; nobody is written to. Tuesday is a glimpse (an episode's problem half, about 10 seconds); Thursday is a rule card (one line, a brand card). Three a week at most, nothing on Sundays.

weekly.label: Status: a rule card
weekly.why: The warm network sees Status; nobody is written to. Tuesday is a glimpse (an episode's problem half, about 10 seconds); Thursday is a rule card (one line, a brand card). Three a week at most, nothing on Sundays.

weekly.label: Status: field or working life (optional)
weekly.why: Saturday is optional: working life or the field, a real photo. Only if there is one; the count stays at three a week at most.

label: Monthly note (opted-in only)
role: Second Wednesday, 10:30 to 11:30 am, only to people who said yes. No note in March.

monthly.label: Monthly note to opted-in contacts
monthly.why: The monthly note goes only to people who said yes in writing, with the date recorded: about 90 words and one carousel PDF, always with "reply stop and I will remove you". Second Wednesday; no note in March.

label: Family WhatsApp Status
role: Once a month at most: the month's most-sent Reel on your father's and sister's Status. Never sent to groups, never as messages.

monthly.label: Family Status: the month's most-sent Reel
monthly.why: Once a month at most, the month's most-sent Reel on family Status. Never to groups, never as a message.

label: In person
role: Events and visits. Stories from the floor, with the host's credit.
